import Mathlib

structure WeightedGraph where
  adj : Array (Array (Nat × Int))

def WeightedGraph.size (g : WeightedGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def WeightedGraph.has_edge (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) (w : Int) : Prop :=
  u < g.size ∧
  ∃ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] ∧ pair.1 = v ∧ pair.2 = w

def WeightedGraph.well_formed (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.size →
    -- Bounds check
    (∀ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → pair.1 < g.size) ∧
    -- Simple graph check (matches Dafny)
    (∀ p1 p2, p1 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p2 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p1.1 = p2.1 → p1 = p2)

structure MSTEdge where
  u : Nat
  v : Nat
  w : Int

-- 1. Validity
def MSTEdge.is_valid (e : MSTEdge) (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  g.has_edge e.u e.v e.w

-- 2. Connectivity for Solution Edges (Undirected View)
-- Dafny: `edge_in_set` checks (u, v) || (v, u)
def edges_contain (edges : List MSTEdge) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ e, e ∈ edges ∧ ((e.u = u ∧ e.v = v) ∨ (e.u = v ∧ e.v = u))

def path_follows_edges (edges : List MSTEdge) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    edges_contain edges (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)

def is_connected_with_edges (g : WeightedGraph) (edges : List MSTEdge) : Prop :=
  ∀ u v, u < g.size → v < g.size →
    ∃ p, p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧ path_follows_edges edges p

-- 3. Spanning Tree Definition
def is_spanning_tree (g : WeightedGraph) (edges : List MSTEdge) : Prop :=
  edges.length = g.size - 1 ∧
  (∀ e, e ∈ edges → e.is_valid g) ∧
  is_connected_with_edges g edges
  -- Note: |V|-1 edges + Connected implies Acyclic (Tree)

def total_weight (edges : List MSTEdge) : Int :=
  edges.foldl (λ sum e => sum + e.w) 0

-- 4. Optimality (MST)
def is_mst (g : WeightedGraph) (edges : List MSTEdge) : Prop :=
  is_spanning_tree g edges ∧
  ∀ other, is_spanning_tree g other → total_weight edges ≤ total_weight other

-- 5. Graph Connectivity (Precondition)
-- Dafny uses directed edges for the graph path check: `graph_has_any_edge`
def path_follows_graph (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    ∃ w, g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0) w

def WeightedGraph.is_connected (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u v, u < g.size → v < g.size →
    ∃ p, p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧ path_follows_graph g p

def WeightedGraph.weights_bounded (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  g.size ≤ 100000 ∧
  ∀ u v w, g.has_edge u v w → w ≥ -100000 ∧ w ≤ 100000

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def kruskal_mst_precond (graph : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed ∧
  graph.size > 0 ∧
  graph.is_connected ∧
  graph.weights_bounded
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode

/-- Disjoint-set (union-find), quick-find flavour: the state is the component
labelling `comp`, `find x = comp x` is a lookup, and `union` relabels one whole
class to the other class's label.  Compared with a pointer forest this trades
`union` cost for a `find` that is definitionally a lookup, which is what makes
the "find tracks connectivity" invariant provable (see ProofState.md). -/
abbrev Comp := Nat → Nat

/-- `n` singleton components: every element is its own label. -/
def Comp.init : Comp := id

/-- Find: the label of `x`. -/
def Comp.find (c : Comp) (x : Nat) : Nat := c x

/-- Union: everything labelled like `b` is relabelled to `a`'s label. -/
def Comp.union (c : Comp) (a b : Nat) : Comp :=
  fun x => if c x = c b then c a else c x

/-- Every directed adjacency entry, as an `MSTEdge`. -/
def allEdges (g : WeightedGraph) : List MSTEdge :=
  (List.range g.size).flatMap
    (fun u => (g.adj.getD u #[]).toList.map (fun pr => ⟨u, pr.1, pr.2⟩))

/-- Greedy scan of the weight-sorted edge list: accept an edge only when its
endpoints lie in different components.  Returns the final labelling together
with the accepted edges (reversed), so that invariants can talk about both. -/
def kruskalRun : List MSTEdge → Comp → List MSTEdge → Comp × List MSTEdge
  | [], c, acc => (c, acc)
  | e :: rest, c, acc =>
      if c.find e.u = c.find e.v then
        kruskalRun rest c acc
      else
        kruskalRun rest (c.union e.u e.v) (e :: acc)

/-- All candidate edges, sorted by weight (step (1) of Kruskal). -/
def sortedEdges (g : WeightedGraph) : List MSTEdge :=
  (allEdges g).mergeSort (fun a b => decide (a.w ≤ b.w))

/-- Final state of the greedy scan on `g`. -/
def kruskalState (g : WeightedGraph) : Comp × List MSTEdge :=
  kruskalRun (sortedEdges g) Comp.init []

/-- Undirected reachability through a list of edges: the reflexive-transitive
closure of `edges_contain`.  This is the relation the union-find classes are
meant to track (invariant I2). -/
def EdgeJoined (edges : List MSTEdge) (x y : Nat) : Prop :=
  Relation.ReflTransGen (fun a b => edges_contain edges a b) x y

-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def kruskal_mst (graph : WeightedGraph)
    (h_precond : kruskal_mst_precond graph) : List MSTEdge :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  (kruskalState graph).2.reverse
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def kruskal_mst_postcond (graph : WeightedGraph) (result : List MSTEdge)
    (_ : kruskal_mst_precond graph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  is_mst graph result
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma

/-- The greedy scan only ever returns edges taken from its input list or its
accumulator: it never invents an edge. -/
theorem mem_kruskalRun :
    ∀ (l : List MSTEdge) (c : Comp) (acc : List MSTEdge) {e : MSTEdge},
      e ∈ (kruskalRun l c acc).2 → e ∈ l ∨ e ∈ acc := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
      intro uf acc e h
      simp only [kruskalRun] at h
      exact Or.inr h
  | cons a t ih =>
      intro uf acc e h
      rw [kruskalRun] at h
      split at h
      · rcases ih _ _ h with h' | h'
        · exact Or.inl (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h')
        · exact Or.inr h'
      · rcases ih _ _ h with h' | h'
        · exact Or.inl (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h')
        · rcases List.mem_cons.mp h' with rfl | h''
          · exact Or.inl (List.mem_cons_self ..)
          · exact Or.inr h''

/-- Every candidate edge produced from the adjacency lists is a genuine edge. -/
theorem valid_of_mem_allEdges (g : WeightedGraph) {e : MSTEdge}
    (he : e ∈ allEdges g) : e.is_valid g := by
  simp only [allEdges, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_map, List.mem_range] at he
  obtain ⟨u, hu, pr, hpr, rfl⟩ := he
  refine ⟨hu, pr, ?_, rfl, rfl⟩
  simpa using hpr

/-- Sorting is a permutation, so it preserves membership. -/
theorem mem_sortedEdges (g : WeightedGraph) {e : MSTEdge} :
    e ∈ sortedEdges g ↔ e ∈ allEdges g :=
  (List.mergeSort_perm _ _).mem_iff

/-- Validity of the returned list (invariant I1 of AlgorithmPlan.md). -/
theorem kruskal_mst_valid (graph : WeightedGraph) (h : kruskal_mst_precond graph) :
    ∀ e ∈ kruskal_mst graph h, e.is_valid graph := by
  intro e he
  simp only [kruskal_mst, kruskalState, List.mem_reverse] at he
  rcases mem_kruskalRun _ _ _ he with h' | h'
  · exact valid_of_mem_allEdges graph ((mem_sortedEdges graph).mp h')
  · simp at h'

/-- Reachability only grows when the edge list grows. -/
theorem edgeJoined_mono {l1 l2 : List MSTEdge} (h : ∀ e ∈ l1, e ∈ l2) {x y : Nat}
    (hj : EdgeJoined l1 x y) : EdgeJoined l2 x y := by
  refine Relation.ReflTransGen.mono ?_ hj
  intro a b hab
  obtain ⟨e, he, hc⟩ := hab
  exact ⟨e, h e he, hc⟩

/-- Invariant I2: equal labels imply undirected connectivity through the accepted
edges.  This is the "find tracks components" obligation of TASK.md. -/
def CompInv (c : Comp) (acc : List MSTEdge) : Prop :=
  ∀ x y, c x = c y → EdgeJoined acc x y

theorem CompInv.init : CompInv Comp.init [] := by
  intro x y h
  have hxy : x = y := h
  subst hxy
  exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl

/-- `union` preserves I2: merging two classes is matched by the newly accepted
edge joining them. -/
theorem CompInv.union {c : Comp} {acc : List MSTEdge} (h : CompInv c acc) (e : MSTEdge) :
    CompInv (c.union e.u e.v) (e :: acc) := by
  have hsub : ∀ f ∈ acc, f ∈ e :: acc := fun f hf => List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hf
  have hup : ∀ x y, c x = c y → EdgeJoined (e :: acc) x y :=
    fun x y hxy => edgeJoined_mono hsub (h x y hxy)
  have huv : EdgeJoined (e :: acc) e.u e.v :=
    Relation.ReflTransGen.single ⟨e, List.mem_cons_self .., Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
  have hvu : EdgeJoined (e :: acc) e.v e.u :=
    Relation.ReflTransGen.single ⟨e, List.mem_cons_self .., Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
  intro x y hxy
  simp only [Comp.union] at hxy
  by_cases hx : c x = c e.v
  · by_cases hy : c y = c e.v
    · exact hup x y (hx.trans hy.symm)
    · rw [if_pos hx, if_neg hy] at hxy
      exact ((hup x e.v hx).trans hvu).trans (hup e.u y hxy)
  · by_cases hy : c y = c e.v
    · rw [if_neg hx, if_pos hy] at hxy
      exact ((hup x e.u hxy).trans huv).trans (hup e.v y hy.symm)
    · rw [if_neg hx, if_neg hy] at hxy
      exact hup x y hxy

/-- The scan maintains I2 from any state satisfying it. -/
theorem kruskalRun_inv : ∀ (l : List MSTEdge) (c : Comp) (acc : List MSTEdge),
    CompInv c acc → CompInv (kruskalRun l c acc).1 (kruskalRun l c acc).2 := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro c acc h; simpa [kruskalRun] using h
  | cons a t ih =>
      intro c acc h
      rw [kruskalRun]
      split
      · exact ih _ _ h
      · exact ih _ _ (h.union a)

/-- Equal labels stay equal: the scan never splits a component. -/
theorem kruskalRun_label_mono :
    ∀ (l : List MSTEdge) (c : Comp) (acc : List MSTEdge) {x y : Nat},
      c x = c y → (kruskalRun l c acc).1 x = (kruskalRun l c acc).1 y := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro c acc x y h; simpa [kruskalRun] using h
  | cons a t ih =>
      intro c acc x y h
      rw [kruskalRun]
      split
      · exact ih _ _ h
      · refine ih _ _ ?_
        simp only [Comp.union, h]

/-- I4: after the whole list has been scanned, both endpoints of every candidate
edge carry the same label — either the edge was rejected because they already
did, or it was accepted and the `union` made them so. -/
theorem kruskalRun_edge_label : ∀ (l : List MSTEdge) (c : Comp) (acc : List MSTEdge),
    ∀ e ∈ l, (kruskalRun l c acc).1 e.u = (kruskalRun l c acc).1 e.v := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro c acc e he; simp at he
  | cons a t ih =>
      intro c acc e he
      rw [kruskalRun]
      split
      · rename_i htest
        simp only [Comp.find] at htest
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp he with rfl | h'
        · exact kruskalRun_label_mono t c acc htest
        · exact ih _ _ e h'
      · rcases List.mem_cons.mp he with rfl | h'
        · refine kruskalRun_label_mono t _ _ ?_
          simp only [Comp.union]
          by_cases hh : c e.u = c e.v <;> simp [hh]
        · exact ih _ _ e h'

/-- Converse of `valid_of_mem_allEdges`: every genuine edge is a candidate. -/
theorem mem_allEdges_of_has_edge {g : WeightedGraph} {u v : Nat} {w : Int}
    (h : g.has_edge u v w) : (⟨u, v, w⟩ : MSTEdge) ∈ allEdges g := by
  obtain ⟨hu, pr, hpr, h1, h2⟩ := h
  simp only [allEdges, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_map, List.mem_range]
  exact ⟨u, hu, pr, by simpa using hpr, by rw [← h1, ← h2]⟩

theorem comp_eq_of_has_edge (g : WeightedGraph) {u v : Nat} {w : Int}
    (h : g.has_edge u v w) : (kruskalState g).1 u = (kruskalState g).1 v := by
  have hmem : (⟨u, v, w⟩ : MSTEdge) ∈ sortedEdges g :=
    (mem_sortedEdges g).mpr (mem_allEdges_of_has_edge h)
  simpa [kruskalState] using
    kruskalRun_edge_label (sortedEdges g) Comp.init [] _ hmem

/-- Labels do not change along a path whose consecutive vertices share a label. -/
theorem comp_eq_of_path (c : Comp) : ∀ (p : List Nat) {u v : Nat},
    (∀ i, i + 1 < p.length → c (p.getD i 0) = c (p.getD (i + 1) 0)) →
    p.head? = some u → p.getLast? = some v → c u = c v := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro u v _ hu _; simp at hu
  | cons a t ih =>
      intro u v hstep hu hv
      simp only [List.head?_cons, Option.some.injEq] at hu
      subst hu
      cases t with
      | nil =>
          simp only [List.getLast?_singleton, Option.some.injEq] at hv
          subst hv
          rfl
      | cons b s =>
          have h0 : c a = c b := by simpa using hstep 0 (by simp)
          have hrest : ∀ i, i + 1 < (b :: s).length →
              c ((b :: s).getD i 0) = c ((b :: s).getD (i + 1) 0) := by
            intro i hi
            simpa using hstep (i + 1) (by simpa using hi)
          exact h0.trans (ih hrest rfl (by simpa using hv))


/-- Reachability through `edges` yields an explicit path witness in the shape the
postcondition's `is_connected_with_edges` demands. -/
theorem path_of_joined (edges : List MSTEdge) {u v : Nat} (h : EdgeJoined edges u v) :
    ∃ p : List Nat,
      p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧ path_follows_edges edges p := by
  induction h using Relation.ReflTransGen.head_induction_on with
  | refl =>
      refine ⟨[v], rfl, rfl, ?_⟩
      refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
      intro i hi
      simp at hi
  | head hac _ ih =>
      obtain ⟨p, hp1, hp2, hp3, hp4⟩ := ih
      obtain ⟨c, q, rfl⟩ : ∃ c q, p = c :: q := by
        cases p with
        | nil => simp at hp1
        | cons a t => exact ⟨a, t, rfl⟩
      simp only [List.head?_cons, Option.some.injEq] at hp1
      subst hp1
      refine ⟨_ :: c :: q, rfl, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simpa using hp2
      · simp
      · intro i hi
        cases i with
        | zero => simpa using hac
        | succ j =>
            have hj : j + 1 < (c :: q).length := by
              simpa using hi
            simpa using hp4 j hj

/-- With the connectivity precondition, the final labelling has a single class on
the vertex set (invariant I4). -/
theorem comp_eq_all (graph : WeightedGraph) (h : kruskal_mst_precond graph)
    {u v : Nat} (hu : u < graph.size) (hv : v < graph.size) :
    (kruskalState graph).1 u = (kruskalState graph).1 v := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp1, hp2, _, hpstep⟩ := h.2.2.1 u v hu hv
  refine comp_eq_of_path _ p ?_ hp1 hp2
  intro i hi
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hpstep i hi
  exact comp_eq_of_has_edge graph hw

/-- Number of distinct component labels carried by the vertices `0, …, n-1`. -/
def numClasses (c : Comp) (n : Nat) : Nat := ((Finset.range n).image c).card

/-- A `union` of two distinct classes removes exactly one label from the image. -/
theorem image_union_eq {c : Comp} {a b n : Nat} (ha : a < n)
    (hne : c a ≠ c b) :
    (Finset.range n).image (c.union a b)
      = ((Finset.range n).image c).erase (c b) := by
  ext y
  simp only [Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_range, Comp.union]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    by_cases hxb : c x = c b
    · rw [if_pos hxb]
      exact ⟨hne, a, ha, rfl⟩
    · rw [if_neg hxb]
      exact ⟨hxb, x, hx, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨hy, x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨x, hx, if_neg hy⟩

/-- I3, one step: accepting an edge drops the class count by exactly one. -/
theorem numClasses_union {c : Comp} {a b n : Nat} (ha : a < n) (hb : b < n)
    (hne : c a ≠ c b) :
    numClasses (c.union a b) n + 1 = numClasses c n := by
  have hmem : c b ∈ (Finset.range n).image c :=
    Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨b, Finset.mem_range.mpr hb, rfl⟩
  have h1 : 1 ≤ ((Finset.range n).image c).card :=
    Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨_, hmem⟩
  simp only [numClasses, image_union_eq ha hne, Finset.card_erase_of_mem hmem]
  omega

/-- I3: `#accepted + #classes` is preserved by the greedy scan. -/
theorem kruskalRun_count : ∀ (l : List MSTEdge) (c : Comp) (acc : List MSTEdge) (n : Nat),
    (∀ e ∈ l, e.u < n ∧ e.v < n) →
    (kruskalRun l c acc).2.length + numClasses (kruskalRun l c acc).1 n
      = acc.length + numClasses c n := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro c acc n _; simp [kruskalRun]
  | cons a t ih =>
      intro c acc n hb
      have hbt : ∀ e ∈ t, e.u < n ∧ e.v < n := fun e he => hb e (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ he)
      obtain ⟨hau, hav⟩ := hb a (List.mem_cons_self ..)
      rw [kruskalRun]
      split
      · exact ih _ _ _ hbt
      · rename_i htest
        simp only [Comp.find] at htest
        have := ih (c.union a.u a.v) (a :: acc) n hbt
        rw [this]
        have hstep := numClasses_union (c := c) (a := a.u) (b := a.v) (n := n) hau hav htest
        simp only [List.length_cons]
        omega

/-- Every candidate edge has both endpoints inside the vertex range. -/
theorem sortedEdges_bounded (graph : WeightedGraph) (h : kruskal_mst_precond graph) :
    ∀ e ∈ sortedEdges graph, e.u < graph.size ∧ e.v < graph.size := by
  intro e he
  have hv := valid_of_mem_allEdges graph ((mem_sortedEdges graph).mp he)
  obtain ⟨hu, pr, hpr, h1, _⟩ := hv
  exact ⟨hu, h1 ▸ (h.1 e.u hu).1 pr hpr⟩

/-- Cardinality (refine_1): the result has exactly `size - 1` edges. -/
theorem kruskal_mst_length (graph : WeightedGraph) (h : kruskal_mst_precond graph) :
    (kruskal_mst graph h).length = graph.size - 1 := by
  have hn : 0 < graph.size := h.2.1
  have hone : numClasses (kruskalState graph).1 graph.size = 1 := by
    have : (Finset.range graph.size).image (kruskalState graph).1
        = {(kruskalState graph).1 0} := by
      ext y
      simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_singleton]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
        exact comp_eq_all graph h hx hn
      · rintro rfl
        exact ⟨0, hn, rfl⟩
    simp [numClasses, this]
  have hinit : numClasses Comp.init graph.size = graph.size := by
    simp [numClasses, Comp.init]
  have hcount := kruskalRun_count (sortedEdges graph) Comp.init [] graph.size
    (sortedEdges_bounded graph h)
  simp only [kruskalState] at hone
  rw [hone, hinit] at hcount
  simp only [List.length_nil] at hcount
  simp only [kruskal_mst, kruskalState, List.length_reverse]
  omega

/-- Spanning (refine_3): the returned edges connect every pair of vertices. -/
theorem kruskal_mst_connected (graph : WeightedGraph) (h : kruskal_mst_precond graph) :
    is_connected_with_edges graph (kruskal_mst graph h) := by
  intro u v hu hv
  have hlabel : (kruskalState graph).1 u = (kruskalState graph).1 v :=
    comp_eq_all graph h hu hv
  have hj : EdgeJoined (kruskalState graph).2 u v :=
    kruskalRun_inv (sortedEdges graph) Comp.init [] CompInv.init u v hlabel
  exact path_of_joined _ (edgeJoined_mono (fun e he => List.mem_reverse.mpr he) hj)

-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem kruskal_mst_postcond_satisfied (graph : WeightedGraph)
    (h_precond : kruskal_mst_precond graph) :
    kruskal_mst_postcond graph (kruskal_mst graph h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  refine ⟨⟨kruskal_mst_length graph h_precond, kruskal_mst_valid graph h_precond,
    kruskal_mst_connected graph h_precond⟩, ?_⟩
  -- !benchmark @end proof
